details.groundedness_reasoning: The citations provide opening-week figures of at least ₹50 crore for several films, and citation [6] lists multiple films whose worldwide gross exceeds ₹100 crore. But the cited passages do not provide opening-week figures for every film in the worldwide-gross list or establish that exactly six films meet both thresholds. In particular, the opening-week list includes Avane Srimannarayana at ₹50 crore, but the citations do not establish that it also grossed ₹100 crore worldwide.
